messages:
nora: Quick thought after the design review: can we add a small inline status pill on each prompt-set row that shows "Reviewed" / "Unreviewed"? would help QA triage. Link to updated mock: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz/inline-status-pills

tess: +1. can the pill be filterable? like a quick dropdown to show only Unreviewed so you can focus on outstanding diffs.

aisha: a11y: pills must be accessible as toggles with aria-pressed state if they act as filters. If they are purely informational, mark as role=status with clear text. Also ensure color isn't the only signal. add icons or underline.

sam: copy: state labels should be verbs or clear nouns. prefer `Unreviewed` / `Reviewed` over `Pending` / `Done`. also spacing: keep pill small so it doesn't push the actions column.

nora: layout: put pill left of title so it reads as metadata, not action. On hover show tooltip `Click to filter by this state`.

aisha: keyboard: allow focus on the pill with tabindex=0 and Enter toggles filter. announce like `Filtering prompt sets to Unreviewed`. use aria-live polite.

tess: interaction edge case: when multiple filters active, pills should show combined state (e.g., `Filtered`). add hover-copy explaining how to clear filters.

ux-bot: Note: created UX ticket UI-5001 for status pill and A11Y-210 for aria and keyboard work.

aisha: also suggest a small change to the scorecard approval flow: when approving a group, the confirm modal should list the top 3 failing examples inline to surface risk. keeps reviewers from blind-approving.

sam: agree. plus include an `Undo` snackbar after bulk approve with `Undo (10s)` CTA. analytics event `promptset.bulk_approve` should include sample ids for audit.

nora: i'll update the figma with pill placement, keyboard states, and a bulk-approve modal mock showing the 3 examples. will link tickets once done. thanks.
